scope: Eight already-inspected development controls only; no fresh holdout content opened
annotation_independence: Published labels external; this semantic audit by owning agent, not independent reannotation

cases.support_assessment: e00 answers the attributed-utterance question directly; its explanation supplies the debate context.
cases.provenance_and_answer_cues: The answer Yes already supplies the decisive annotation. A transcript URL is not a verified transcript quotation.
cases.single_context_requirement: Distinguish saying an amount from that amount being economically correct; ignore tax-windfall and projected-profit distractors.
cases.exchange_headroom: One decisive QA record; no evidence-distribution bottleneck.

cases.support_assessment: e01 repeats the whole claim directly. e00 uses >=2 rather than >2; e02 is later and internally inconsistent about above-threshold places.
cases.provenance_and_answer_cues: Original URL path repeats the count/threshold; removing paths fixes that shortcut but not the claim restatement in the answer.
cases.single_context_requirement: Use dated evidence and flag threshold/date mismatch rather than tally three agreeing sources.
cases.exchange_headroom: Direct supplied answer can solve this packet; extracting a real daily-price table would be a different case.

cases.support_assessment: e02 explains washing/removal; e03 explains subsequent application before sale. e00 alone does not establish the shop stage.
cases.provenance_and_answer_cues: URL topic hints at waxing; the QA answers explicitly contain the required transition. Four records belong to one document.
cases.single_context_requirement: Compose wash/remove then coat/sell without treating the negative natural-wax answer as a negative applied-wax answer.
cases.exchange_headroom: Useful semantic control, but all necessary distinctions fit in one short context.

cases.mechanism: Specific causal allegation versus documented medical account
cases.support_assessment: e02 supplies an alternative medical account; e01 supplies a negative reputation description. Neither gives a complete investigation of the specific allegation.
cases.provenance_and_answer_cues: The claim URL echoes the accusation, not the correct verdict. Source-reputation text is a strong answer cue but not decisive factual refutation.
cases.single_context_requirement: Separate source credibility, lack of support and positive disproof; permit uncertainty rather than penalize it against an under-supported hard label.
cases.exchange_headroom: Do not use as a strict four-label native scorer without clearer causal evidence; no relabeling performed.

cases.support_assessment: e00 contains the attributed tweet without a ranking of groups; e02 explicitly declares the claim disconnected from that tweet. This supports refuting the interpretation of that identified tweet, not exhaustive proof of every utterance.
cases.provenance_and_answer_cues: e02 includes the annotator conclusion inside actor-visible evidence. The claim URL repeats the accusation; it does not independently validate it.
cases.single_context_requirement: Compare quoted content to claimed comparative judgment, scoped to the identified source.
cases.exchange_headroom: Direct conclusion leakage limits diagnostic value; removing it would create a new packet needing label-support review.

cases.support_assessment: e01 gives a count without establishing exhaustive scope; e02 adds other categories and e03 explicitly says the intended category is unspecified. The list is visibly truncated.
cases.provenance_and_answer_cues: A URL path repeats the claimed69 even though gold is insufficient evidence. The unknown-category QA explicitly cues abstention.
cases.single_context_requirement: Check definition, scope and list completeness before substituting41 for69 or counting listed names.
cases.exchange_headroom: A useful abstention control; additional agents cannot supply absent category definitions from the same packet.

cases.mechanism: Planned versus completed and unresolved total
cases.support_assessment: e03 separates planning/construction/completion and explicitly says its computed total is difficult to verify. Missing baseline and date alignment prevent reconstructing the claim totals.
cases.provenance_and_answer_cues: No obvious verdict in source paths; the uncertainty verdict is already stated in the answer text.
cases.single_context_requirement: Keep status counts separate, require a reconciliation baseline, and abstain rather than invent how188 becomes975.
cases.exchange_headroom: A useful missing-data control, not proof exchange resolves the missing reconciliation.

cases.mechanism: Version and quantifier of legislative opposition
cases.support_assessment: e01 states that all but eight Republican senators opposed the final bill while an earlier version had broad support. The claim gives no version or universal quantifier; Supported is also reasonable for final-version opposition.
cases.provenance_and_answer_cues: Legislative URLs identify versions/votes, not verdicts. Narrative commentary is attributed to primary-source URLs without source-text verification.
cases.single_context_requirement: Disambiguate bill version, chamber, date and whether Republicans means some/most/all; do not force a unique gold label before that is specified.
cases.exchange_headroom: Quarantine from exact-label scoring; preserve the published conflicting label and record the alternative reading.
